UPDATE "webhook_deliveries" c SET "tenant_id" = p."tenant_id" FROM "webhooks" p WHERE c."webhook_id" = p."id";
ALTER TABLE "webhook_deliveries" ALTER COLUMN "tenant_id" SET NOT NULL;
